verdict.rationale: Helicone logs production requests and exposes them through a request query API and HQL. Its Playground lets you 'test and iterate on prompts, sessions and traces'. Webhooks enable 'real-time evaluation' scoring in external systems. Together these give only glancing, do-it-yourself support for building datasets from traces and evaluating against them. Missing for 10: a documented first-party dataset curation feature, offline/batch evaluation runs against curated datasets, built-in evaluators or experiment comparison, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
